description: This file defines the ProjectActivityDao class responsible for database operations related to project activities within the OrangeHRM Time module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, copying, and deleting project activities, as well as validating activity names and handling duplicated activities.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling project activity entities, offering methods for CRUD operations, validation, duplication, and complex queries related to project activities.

methods.name: getProjectActivityListByProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of project activities for a given project ID based on search filters.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object configured with query filters for project activities.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCount
methods.description: Counts the number of project activities matching given filters for a specific project.

methods.name: saveProjectActivity
methods.description: Persists a new or updated project activity entity.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Fetches a Project entity by its ID.

methods.name: getProjectActivityByProjectIdAndProjectActivityId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ProjectActivity by its ID within a specific project.

methods.name: getExistingProjectActivityIdsForProject
methods.description: Checks for existing project activity IDs within a project.

methods.name: hasActivityGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Checks if an activity has associated timesheet entries.

methods.name: deleteProjectActivities
methods.description: Marks specified project activities as deleted; throws exception if activities have timesheet entries.

methods.name: isProjectActivityNameTaken
methods.description: Validates if a project activity name already exists within a project, excluding a specific activity ID if provided.

methods.name: getDuplicatedActivities
methods.description: Finds duplicated activity names across two projects.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesByActivityIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple project activities based on their IDs.

methods.name: copyActivities
methods.description: Copies activities from one project to another.

methods.name: getActivitiesCountByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Counts activities matching provided ID pairs for projects.

methods.name: getActivitiesPaginatorByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Builds a paginator for activities matching specific ID pairs.
